name: nvm
description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions.

latest_release.name: v0.41.0
latest_release.body:
## New Stuff
 - select versions by category: `alpha`, `lts`, `non-lts`, `iojs`; exclude alphas by default
 - `nvm alias`: store `--lts` and `--lts=<name>`
 - record every node version's LTS status
 - `nvm ls-remote`: annotate versions with the `node` alias and local aliases (#3920)
 - add `nvm_has_italics`, to detect terminal italics support via terminfo

## Bug Fixes
 - `nvm`: treat a bare `--only` like an empty `--only=`
 - `nvm_ls_remote`, `nvm_remote_version`: match dots between version components literally (#3982)
 - `nvm_nvmrc_invalid_msg`: respect `--silent`
 - `nvm_download`: pass `$NVM_AUTH_HEADER` to curl and GNU Wget in a config file, not as an argument
 - `nvm_ls_remote_index_tab`, `nvm_remote_version`, `nvm_ls_cached`: pass the version pattern to grep with `-e`
 - `nvm_die_on_prefix`: never let a project `.npmrc` choose which npmrc file `--delete-prefix` edits
 - `nvm_download_artifact`: only put an archive in the cache once its checksum has passed
 - `nvm_normalize_lts`, `nvm_ls_remote_index_tab`: keep untrusted text out of shell arithmetic and LTS aliases
 - `nvm install`: keep nvm options after the version out of `./configure` (#3981)
 - `nvm install`: apply `--alias`, `--default` and `--save` after every install (#3981)
 - `nvm install`: don't leave `NVM_NO_PROGRESS` set in the caller's shell
 - `nvm_get_default_packages`: ignore CRLF line endings (#3979)
 - `install.sh`: ignore commented-out profile source lines (#3860)
 - `nvm_print_implicit_alias`: keep `STABLE` bound, and `STABLE` and `UNSTABLE` independent of the caller (#3975)
 - `nvm_ls`: treat a version dir with only hidden entries as empty (#3974)
 - `ls`: list versions whose directory is a symlink (#3973)
 - `nvm_die_on_prefix`: check a nonexistent prefix on Windows (#3972)
 - `install.sh`: only write `$HOME` when `$NVM_DIR` is inside it (#3962)
 - `nvm_is_version_or_alias`: reject uppercase LTS names in every locale
 - `nvm_process_nvmrc`: don't show the content of a symlinked `.nvmrc`
 - `nvm_write_nvmrc`: don't write through a symlinked `.nvmrc`
 - `nvm_ls`: match `NVM_DIR` literally
 - `nvm use`: do not pile up `PATH` entries in nested sessions (#3959)
 - `nvm_filter_installed_versions`, `nvm_filter_lts_versions`, `nvm_record_lts_status`, `nvm_get_default_packages`: keep backslashes in `NVM_DIR` paths
 - `nvm_strip_path`: preserve literal backslashes in `NVM_DIR` (#3958)
 - `nvm_find_up`, `nvm_find_project_dir`: stop at a Windows drive root instead of looping forever (#3968)
 - `nvm_ls_cached`: match dots in the version literally, and ignore a trailing dot (#3961)
 - `install.sh`: `nvm_check_global_modules`: don't run a Windows npm under WSL (#3966)
 - `nvm`: ignore option variables set by the caller
 - `nvm reinstall-packages`: don't print `VERSION=''` in zsh
 - `nvm_alias`, `nvm_ls_remote_index_tab`, `nvm use`: return the exit code of a failed check
 - `nvm_print_versions`: don't mark `N/A` as installed
 - `nvm_ls`: no blank line before `system` when nothing is installed
 - `nvm_print_versions`: widen the version column for long versions
 - `nvm_ls`: match a prerelease only up to a `.`
 - `nvm_ls`: list every installed prerelease, in semver order
 - `nvm uninstall`: only remove aliases that point at the uninstalled version
 - `nvm_ls_cached`: only match whole version numbers
 - `nvm debug`: don't let the shell read stdin when asked for its version
 - `nvm_download`: with GNU Wget, follow only same-origin redirects when sending `$NVM_AUTH_HEADER`
 - `nvm_download`: only send `$NVM_AUTH_HEADER` to URLs under a mirror it applies to
 - `install.sh`: don't let a git repository in the current directory affect `git ls-remote`
 - `nvm_remote_versions`: only consult io.js's version list for majors 1 through 3
 - `nvm_remote_versions`: place io.js versions by major version, not at the literal `v4.0.0`
 - `nvm.sh`: detect `NVM_DIR` without `$0`/`$_`; fall back to the default install location instead of t
